description:
Ji Hyeonseok and Kim Beomwoo have been friends for seven years. To anyone who can see straight, it is obvious they are stuck in mutual unrequited love, but oblivious Hyeonseok treats Beomwoo like a convenient pushover.

It escalates to the point where a nasty rumor spreads through their department that “Kim Beomwoo from Mechanical Design is Ji Hyeonseok’s doormat.” Even then, Hyeonseok thinks everything is Beomwoo’s fault for indulging his every unreasonable demand.

Then one day, Hyeonseok finds a mysterious package in Beomwoo’s studio apartment and learns that Beomwoo has someone he is secretly in love with…
